responsibility: Declares the Indexing module’s opaque dynamic index type and the operations for creating, resizing, querying, deleting, and iterating index entries that map unsigned indices to generic pointers. This header defines the reusable handle-table abstraction used by neighboring runtime modules such as FIO, separate from the tree-structured NameKey and SymbolKey facilities.
same_name_distinction: This header presents Indexing as an opaque handle type and declares the index procedures and callback type for clients such as FIO. Unlike gcc/m2/pge-boot/GIndexing.cc, it does not expose the internal array bookkeeping fields or implement resizing and element management.
